title: Troy Schliemann trench 2658.jpg
author: Dosseman
description: During the first three years of his campaign, Schliemann chose to work in a 40-m wide trench laid out N-S across the middle of the mound. This was a sondage 17 meters in depth (opened clear to the bedrock), an attempt to find the "City of Priam."
